headline: Bitcoin Rises 4% as Midterms Lessen Fears of Severe Crypto Regulation
summary: Bitcoin gained 4% as the US midterm elections provided greater clarity, with markets perceiving that Democrats will not bring major setbacks or harsh regulations to the crypto sector.
why: US regulatory sentiment and legislative balances directly influence institutional risk appetite and valuations across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Electoral outcomes eased perceived regulatory risks for the cryptocurrency sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reduced political risk regarding regulatory crackdowns improves sentiment among digital asset investors, driving buying pressure.
